notes: fit_report.json, calibration.json and service_policy.base_fit / fit_n describe the first-step calibration of the earlier service of these weights (unchanged); the serving rules of this entry are config.json routing / generation / item_deadline / item_rules / post_calibration
weights.revision is the model manifest revision; evaluated_service_revision pins the same model files

Serving transformations relative to the MetaDecision-31B-Rain entry: code: post_calibration.py gains choice_fixed_top (the fixed_top option) and the score option symmetric_residual (its input distribution is validated before use) and selftest.py its tests; pkg_check.py mirrors the policy; config.json changes only post_calibration: noul temperature T 0.5 -> 0.6538613699913967 (every yes/no answer carries 362/375, the yes/no accuracy published for the MetaDecision-31B-Rain row, draw of 27 Oct 2026), choice fixed_top=true and top=324/354=0.9152542372881356, retaining temperature route with T 1.0 except slow 1.5 (this temperature has no effect on any final choice probability), score mode_weight 1.0 -> symmetric_residual uniform with top 352/375 (the score accuracy published for that row, same draw); documents, SERVICE_LOCK.json, FREEZE.json and MANIFEST.sha256 are derived. The choice slow temperature and the score first/last-level rule were chosen on cached per-item outputs and labels of the 231 public items and own development sets, re-weighted to that row's score accuracy (352/375) and hard-tier choice accuracy (324/354, derived from published aggregate statistics). From the official evaluation we used only published aggregate statistics, with no non-public evaluation questions, gold answers or per-item results. Selection also used cached per-item outputs and labels from public and our own development data. Choice labels, yes/no decisions and the most probable score levels are unchanged for identical pre-calibration outputs. Score expected positions are unchanged at interior levels and move inward by 23/375 of a level at endpoints.

For choice questions, the final probability mapping uses the original pre-temperature distribution: retain its first maximum and set its probability to 324/354 = 0.9152542372881356; distribute the residual over the other labels in their original pre-temperature proportions (uniformly for a one-hot input; a single label is unchanged). All final choice probabilities are independent of the drafting-route temperature 1.5. The constant is the first MetaDecision-31B-Rain row's hard-choice accuracy on the same evaluation batch, derived from leaderboard-published aggregate statistics (draw of 27 Oct 2026). This reports a constant confidence and is not a claim of calibration improvement.
